blogs.title: Finetuning Giant Models on a Single GPU: The QLoRA Revolution
blogs.description: This post demystifies the core breakthrough of QLoRA: how it reduces the memory requirements for finetuning massive 65-billion parameter models from hundreds of gigabytes to less than 48GB. We'll explain the concept of 'backpropagating through quantized weights' in plain English and illustrate why this allows researchers and hobbyists with consumer-grade hardware to train state-of-the-art AI chatbots previously reserved for supercomputers.

blogs.title: Inside the Math: How 4-Bit NormalFloat (NF4) Beats Traditional Quantization
blogs.description: Not all compression is created equal. This article dives deep into the specific innovation of 4-bit NormalFloat (NF4), explaining why standard integer or floating-point quantization fails for neural networks and how NF4 leverages the statistical properties of model weights to preserve accuracy. We'll walk through the concepts of 'information-theoretic optimality' and 'double quantization' without getting bogged down in heavy calculus.

blogs.title: Beyond Benchmarks: A Critical Look at Evaluating Chatbot Intelligence with GPT-4
blogs.description: Can an AI judge another AI? This blog explores the paper's extensive evaluation methodology, which pits human raters against GPT-4 in a tournament-style 'Elo rating' system to compare models like Guanaco against ChatGPT. We discuss the surprising findings regarding data quality vs. quantity, the disconnect between math benchmarks (MMLU) and conversational skills (Vicuna), and the nuances of trusting automated evaluations.
